# Three.js r180 (0.180.0)

Locally hosted MIT-licensed browser modules, approved by the portfolio owner
for the Greeny garden on 2026-11-05. No npm install or build is required.

Unmodified upstream files from `https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180`:

- `build/three.module.min.js`
- `build/three.core.min.js`
- `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`
- `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`
- `LICENSE`

The import map on Greeny's page maps `three` and `three/addons/` to these
local copies. Upgrading requires replacing all modules from the same release
and rechecking the garden. No CDN requests are made by the website.
